result.summary: The landlord approved the work, Riverside Works was assigned and a visit was arranged for after 10:30 am on 8 or 9 August. Since then the CRM has no attendance report and no word from the contractor or tenant (event 014). I emailed Riverside Works and the tenant asking what happened and placed a 1-day hold to chase. Nothing yet needs a human.
result.situation: Stage is 'works'. The toilet has to be removed to clear a blockage lodged by the pan connector. The visit was agreed on a call at 05:03 on 08/08: "next day after 10:30". The confirmations said "tomorrow after half ten (08/08/2026)", so the visit date was either the 8th or the 9th. As of 2026-08-11 the CRM has no attendance or outcome.

actions_taken.description: Loaded the ticket, profiles, events and approvals
actions_taken.result: 14 events; approval 26 shows approved; no holds, attachments or property history

actions_taken.description: Emailed Riverside Works asking whether they attended and on what date, whether the toilet is working, and what is left to do with a quote if needed. Reminded them to quote before any extra work.
Emailed the tenant asking whether the contractor came, whether the toilet works and whether there is another WC. Advised not to flush the blocked toilet.
Hold waiting on the contractor and tenant replies, with a 1-day follow-up

escalation.reason: Routine chase: the contractor and tenant can say what happened
escalation.recommendation: Escalate if neither replies by the follow-up date, or if the contractor quotes extra costs, since the landlord's approval has no amount.
